segments.fit: every pair of consecutive samples of the fit part (in-sample residual)
segments.eval_all: every pair of consecutive samples of the evaluation part
segments.window: for each E2 window start i and horizon H steps, the instants i+1..i+H, each predicted from the measured level at the instant before; errors of all windows of a run pooled into one RMSE

config.fit_rows: fit rows copied from E2 models.csv (rmse = fit_rmse_pct, n_errors = n_pairs); recomputed with predict_step only as a check, rtol 1e-10
config.prediction: lifted state built from the measured level (and measured delays), advanced one step with predict_step
config.ties: exactly equal RMSE, counted apart from both sides
config.multistep_source: tables/errors.csv of the E2 results (column rmse, same horizon)
checks: E2 metadata clean and with config.coefficients_table
a model for every run and dictionary in tables/coefficients.csv of E2
in-sample one-step RMSE recomputed with predict_step equals fit_rmse_pct of E2 (rtol 1e-10), and its number of errors equals n_pairs
window starts equal tables/windows.csv of E2
